description: This file defines the AuthorizationException class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for handling authorization-related exceptions. It extends the base PHP Exception class and provides static methods for generating specific exception messages related to unsupported entities, unimplemented entities, and unimplemented methods.

classes.name: AuthorizationException
classes.description: A custom exception class for authorization errors within the OrangeHRM system, providing static factory methods for common authorization exception scenarios.

methods.name: entityNotSupported
methods.description: Creates an AuthorizationException indicating that a specific entity type is not supported in a given method.

methods.name: entityNotImplemented
methods.description: Creates an AuthorizationException indicating that a specific entity type is not implemented in a given method.

methods.name: methodNotImplemented
methods.description: Creates an AuthorizationException indicating that a method is not implemented.
